newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $103 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $103 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 5.615 billion shillings ($103 million) of treasury bills at the weekly auction on Thursday, bank officials said.
The bank sold 2.977 billion shillings of the main 91-day category at an average yield of 18.720 percent compared to 2.218 billion shillings at an average yield of 18.961 percent last week.
In the 182-day category, the bank sold 2.637 billion shillings at an average yield of 19.545 percent from 157 million shillings at an average yield of 19.572 percent.
The bank invited tenders for 11 billion shillings for next week's auction on Thursday. ($1=54.80 Kenyan Shillings)
